name: Sneed's Shredder
summary: Deep in the Deadmines, Sneed's Shredder cuts timber and guards the works. Goblin taskmaster Sneed pilots the machine for Edwin VanCleef's shipwrights, turning its blades against intruders.

sections.title: Industrial Terror
sections.body: In the Deadmines foundry, goblin shredders cut timber for Edwin VanCleef's hidden juggernaut. They also meet intruders with armored force. Sneed oversees the lumber works and pilots this modified machine himself, wielding its oversized buzzsaw as a weapon of defense.

sections.title: A Deadly Cockpit
sections.body: Sneed rides above the spinning blades in an open cockpit, protected by heavy iron plating. The machine's clatter can scatter his foes. When the shredder breaks down and collapses in sparks, Sneed leaps from the wreckage and fights on.

faq.q: What is Sneed's Shredder used for in the Deadmines?
aliases: why is there a shredder in deadmines
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood uses goblin machinery to cut through stone and process timber for its secret juggernaut. Sneed's Shredder mills wood and enforces order in the underground works.

faq.q: What happens when the shredder is destroyed?
aliases: does sneed die with the shredder
faq.answer: When the shredder breaks down, Sneed survives. The goblin pilot emerges from the wreckage with his own weapons and attacks intruders fiercely.

faq.q: Why do the Defias Brotherhood have goblin technology?
faq.answer: Edwin VanCleef hired goblin engineers, craftsmen, and mercenary laborers to run mechanical works beneath Westfall, including steam powered forges, gun foundries, and woodmills.

faq.q: Can the shredder be hacked or controlled by engineers?
faq.answer: A Gnomish Universal Remote can briefly override the shredder's controls and wrest command from Sneed.

faq.q: Does Sneed's Shredder carry anything valuable?
faq.answer: Yes. The intact power supply, the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, is sought by Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind. She needs it to power the gnomes' gyrodrillmatic excavationators for an assault on Gnomeregan.
Sneed, a goblin supervisor, pilots the machine and directs logging and carpentry deep in the Deadmines.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can briefly override the shredder with a Gnomish Universal Remote.
As a gnome, you know Shoni the Shilent wants the goblin built machine's power supply to drive drills for an assault on Gnomeregan.
As an Alliance member, you can cripple the lumber works supporting Edwin VanCleef's secret war fleet by defeating Sneed and his machine.
